The Senior Staff Association of Nigerian Universities has given the federal government a one-month ultimatum to complete the renegotiation of the 2009 agreement with the non-teaching university unions, or else trigger an indefinite nationwide strike. This follows resolutions passed at their 54th National Executive Council meeting.

These threats amount to a direct assault on established authority and the social order that sustains our nation. By holding the education of our youth hostage, the unions are undermining the family stability and national strength that rest on reliable institutions and cultural continuity. This is not responsible conduct or respect for tradition but deliberate disruption that erodes personal responsibility and weakens our foundations. The government must refuse to yield and instead enforce order against such tactics.
